original.title: Student Involvement: A Developmental Theory for Higher Education
original.note: Reprint chapter (2014) of the 1984 Journal of College Student Personnel article.

core_idea: Students learn and develop in proportion to the physical and psychological energy they invest in academic and campus life. Involvement has quantity and quality.
key_concepts_note: Use the concepts already stored for this theory in the library (theories.concepts).
when_to_use: How does involvement in activities relate to student outcomes?
Typical data: surveys, institutional data, interviews.
common_mistakes: Counting hours in activities and ignoring quality.
Confusing involvement (what students do) with engagement as institutions measure it.
Treating it as causal without controlling for input characteristics (Astin's I-E-O model).
